problem:
Given that the mean of the following data set is $10,$ find the value of $b:$ 

$$
b,\,1,\,b,\,1,\,b
$$

feedback.problem:
Given that the mean of the following data set is $8,$ find the value of $w:$ 

$$
7,\,w,\,8,\,5,\,11,\,(w-1)
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
If we have a data set that consists of the points ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n},$ then the mean is denoted by $\overset{―}{x}$ and is given by the following formula:

$$
\overset{―}{x}=\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i}
$$

Here, there are $n=6$ data points. Adding up all the points in the data set, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{6}{x}_{i} & =7+w+8+5+11+(w-1) \\  & =30+2w.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the mean is given by the expression

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{x} & =\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i} \\  & =\frac{1}{6}\cdot (30+2w) \\  & =\frac{30+2w}{6}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, since we're told that $\overset{―}{x}=8,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}8 & =\frac{30+2w}{6} \\ 48 & =30+2w \\ 18 & =2w \\ w & =9.\end{aligned}
$$
